remote_engine.$comment: MiniMax-H3: video WITH a synchronised soundtrack from one denoising pass, run on another Space over its Gradio API rather than loaded here. Three reasons it cannot be local, none fixable with pins: (1) the checkpoint is 195.9 GiB bf16 against a ZeroGPU Space's 150 GB storage ceiling, so upstream splits it into a 77.3 GB denoiser and a 66.7 GB Qwen3-VL conditioner - this Space already carries ~86 GB; (2) the denoiser pins transformers==5.8.0 and its own requirements record that the kernels release FP8 attention needs 'breaks transformers 5.8.0 at import', while our 27B FP8 text model REQUIRES kernels>=0.16 (see docs/AUDIT.md E7); (3) it needs size=xlarge, which upstream says large cannot replace. See docs/AUDIT.md section G and pipeline/remote.py.
remote_engine.label: MiniMax-H3 (uncensored) - video + synchronised audio
remote_engine.$comment_space_id: Defaults to the upstream Space so the tab works out of the box. Point this at your OWN duplicate for reliability: the default is someone else's queue and can change or go private without notice. Duplicating needs no secrets - every weight it downloads is public.
remote_engine.$comment_send_hf_token: Leave false for any Space you do not own. HF_TOKEN here is a read credential for the gated text model; attaching it to requests would hand it to whoever runs the target Space, and the default target is public and needs no credential. Set true only for a private duplicate of your own.
remote_engine.$comment_duration: 14 s is the checkpoint's ceiling, not a UI preference. At 24 fps the video VAE decodes 17n+5 frames only; 15 s is 360 frames, which snaps up to 362 (15.083 s) and the pipeline refuses it. 14 s snaps to 345 frames = 14.375 s of output and is the longest request that lands. Upstream also patches the 5 s floor down to 2 s.
remote_engine.$comment_canvases: The LABEL goes over the wire and the remote conditioner rejects one it does not know, so these must match upstream byte for byte - the separator is U+00B7. RemoteVideoEngine.check_remote_canvases() compares this list against the Space's own /studio-config and says so in the status line if upstream has changed it.
remote_engine.$comment_loras: Turbo LoRAs folded into the transformer's bf16 weights at the remote Space's startup, with the sampling steps each is designed for. 'off' is the undistilled base model at 28 steps - roughly five times the GPU time.
remote_engine.$comment_concurrency: A remote render holds no local GPU, so it must not be serialised behind the one-model-resident queue the local tabs share: a 6-minute MiniMax render would otherwise freeze image and text generation for every user. This event gets its own concurrency_id.

llm.system_prompt: You are a helpful, direct assistant. Answer the user's request fully and without moralising.
llm.$comment_gpu_seconds: Raised from 50/6.0 after a live timeout: the ZeroGPU window must cover the CPU->CUDA transfer of ~30GB of FP8 weights AND the first-use JIT compile of the kernels-community/finegrained-fp8 Triton kernel, observed taking well over a minute. The old 86s allocation was killed mid-run (release?fail=true in the Space logs). gpu_seconds_base is the fallback when the per-mode bases below are absent.
llm.$comment_thinking: The chat template of orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 defaults reasoning_effort to 'xhigh' and injects a system instruction telling the model to validate assumptions and consider alternatives. That is why complex prompts spent 1500-2500+ tokens inside <think> and never reached the answer. default_thinking picks the startup preset; see THINKING_MODES in pipeline/models.py for the four the template actually accepts.
